checks.basis: Morning overprediction and afternoon underprediction are both reported; annual bias hides shape error.
One focal room and seven training groups; time rows are not independent room samples.
BM702 selected after poor test results; diagnosis is post-holdout and representative-room sampling is limited.
No causal regression adjustment; geometry distances and leaf weights are descriptive.
Low actual illuminance in DNI=0 subset noted; label distributions shown alongside MAE.
No model improvement or new performance claim; oracle substitution not a deployable result.
All 17520 BM702 rows retained; no outlier deletion.
Strata are diagnostic; no model or correction chosen by best BM702 score.
Exploratory analysis and resulting proposal explicitly marked; no candidate training this turn.
Negative-X saturation is measured; its fraction of total physical error is not causally identified.
Truth used only in clearly labeled oracle diagnostics; model inputs remain feature-only.
